value.rationale: Motivated by published Platonic-solid Rips classification and its stated Archimedean gap, this computes a natural previously undetermined invariant of a canonical truncated sixty-vertex cubic graph. The stable eleven-circle region jumps at radius four to simultaneous mod-two degrees two and four, with the exact fourth-degree multiplicity twelve. This is a meaningful mixed-degree filtration transition, not an arbitrary subgraph slice or incremental table recomputation; exact finite calculation is the intended contribution.
